description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Relic of Sauron by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Relic of Sauron.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Reality Chip
uses.cardState: attached to a creature you control
